entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states and is available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as a memory engine and API. It features a custom vector graph engine, automated fact extraction, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that acts as an open-source context database. It utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing and employs L0, L1, and L2 tiered loading layers.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and offers Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repo using brv vc commit, branch, and merge versioning. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface and supports 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency AI memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents succeed on complex tasks. It provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets and supports multiple agent providers.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a DAG-based context engine. It utilizes a SQLite-backed message store to build a depth-aware summary DAG for compacted history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides identity, memory, and secrets management for agents, supporting portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It maintains local custody of SQLite and workspace files while averaging 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It is designed for multi-agent systems and provides local-first, zero-cost search for Hermes and other clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates without cloud dependencies via Claude Code hooks, MCP, or Hermes plugins. It employs hybrid retrieval through BM25, vector search, and graph traversal, using a local GGUF observer model to automate decision capture.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This durable, file-based memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family that includes a Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It features built-in contradiction tracking, recency ranking, and owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp to provide an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory solution uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only the necessary context. It renders context locally without hosted services and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This long-term, cross-project memory system uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin supports real, immediate event deletion and provides a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation. It utilizes an on-demand summarizer to manage agent memory.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage state updates.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-mode execution. It offers hybrid retrieval through HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides five native tools for indexing and routing local knowledge, including scripts, markdown documents, and cron jobs. It supports an opt-in process for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search approach combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A that includes file-and-line citations while running locally over localhost.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes a subagent-driven-development methodology for task execution. It is essential for agents requiring structured brainstorming and design refinement phases.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports while offering CLI support for coding agents. It enables automation and plugin features within a design system environment.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients for managing ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills mapped across 29 security domains. These skills align with six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using three operational modes. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Cursor, and offers optional voice profiles.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an agentic evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents via the skills.sh interface.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It incorporates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution as an open skill.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for use with ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model and structured memory. It utilizes file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to facilitate smart contract interaction.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides skills in SKILL.md format and installation guides in Portuguese. It supports the agentskills.io standard for Hermes Agent users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI for managing reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes TON-based commerce features.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress, alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This project provides an Intent as Code workflow language using a single Rust binary and four verbs. It supports static auditing via nika check and generates tamper-evident, hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This MCP client utilizes a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and provides incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill employs a 5-layer retrieval system, including dense embeddings and hard triggers, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. It uses RRF fusion and provides graceful degradation if dependencies or embedding models are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces, including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill uses three parallel subagents to analyze code for edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It integrates a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec, and uses an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for task state management and a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing and one-click installation through the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill uses a three-agent swarm to target code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports the Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents and terminal tools, including Hermes. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama as well as providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module provides declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and integrates secure secrets via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps through a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local MCP server that creates a pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls. It supports multiple programming languages and includes automatic synchronization for file changes.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across various AI coding agents. It supports data from clients including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect real API traffic and agent context for multiple coding agents. It enables comparison of adjacent requests and supports exporting local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and offers historical usage trends and breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows, along with action undo and session snapshots.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, and the Claude Agent SDK. It includes editor tooling for VS Code, Slack, and Telegram, and a plugin for Claude Code to capture tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes JSON, YAML, text, markdown, and Python files, including relational checks for tool description distinction.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files to establish config-aware baselines.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It enables management of multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local open-source cowork app provides a single interface for multiple external agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. It features 21 built-in professional assistants and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging apps.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript implementation that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The interface utilizes a three-panel layout featuring chat and workspace file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode and includes a Monaco editor and PTY terminal.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports delegation to sub-agents and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It features an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows and macOS desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to a Hermes Agent runtime. It supports local, cloud, or remote gateways and includes Hermes Web for full-page sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It provides real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit designed for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers live per-session quota burn tracking and processes all data locally without telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace for managing Hermes Agent on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: A TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. The interface includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed as a Telegram Mini App with a 10-page UI. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and allows for background agent spawning with up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for managing requests that involve side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop application that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports connections to local and cloud AI models and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent sessions. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and process monitoring dashboard for Hermes. It enables real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store for one-click installations and streaming SSE responses.
